name: ListGetDuplicates
description: Gets a list of duplicate values from a list.
syntax: ListGetDuplicates( string list, [string delimiters], [boolean ignoreCase], [boolean includeEmptyFields] )

params.name: delimiters
params.description: Characters that separate list elements. The default value is comma.

params.name: ignoreCase
params.description: if set to true, the duplicate value test will not be case sensitive

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: if set to true, empty values are included as well
